name: 40k_wars
label: 40k Wars
description: Gothic grand strategy in the Warhammer 40,000 universe: ten campaigns (Armageddon, Damocles, Cadia, the Great Game of the Gods, Thaurus, Badab, Vraks, Baal, the Plague War, Sautekh) with 22 playable factions and chained crusades. Special resources, rituals and upgrades, Daemon Princes, generals with levels, traits, relics and battle powers, truces and betrayals, events, buildings, public order and revolts, legendary foes, tactical space battles and 2D battles with weather, walls, reinforcements, morale and miniatures. Skirmish, codex, sound and music. English, Portuguese and Spanish. No other mods required.
